webster.text: Theft; the act of taking and carrying away the goods or property of another feloniously.

example.quote: They may legislate, in criminal cases, from treason to the lowest offence — petty larceny.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 16, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
